model: TUDOR Royal 36 M2836C1A0-0106 (steel, light blue dial, baton indices, bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Same case, bezel, crown and bracelet template as -0101 (silhouette and bracelet identical in the photo). The light blue sunburst dial, applied blue baton indices, TUDOR print, date window and minute track come from one 2x photo map with the photographed hands left in it (the 3D hands, which carry the photographed blue and white lume, cover them).

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette into the bracelet; the top is brushed and slopes down toward the bracelet

bezel.note: 48 segments of 7.5 deg: plain polished facets centred at 0, 15, 30 deg ..., ribbed facets between (5 radial ribs), phase read from the photo

hands.note: half widths slightly under the photographed hands (the 0103/0101 +0.1 mm cover was dropped: as on the silver -0104 dial it can leave a grey rim around the hands; the photographed hands stay in the dial map and show at the edges); hands and hub use the steel_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

bracelet.note: Flat bracelet: row joints and polished pieces are the positions measured in the photo (top and bottom differ because of the photo's perspective), so the front view lines up with it. No curl: the photo's foreshortening is built into the row positions.

steel_groove.note: shaded bottoms of the bezel grooves

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
